messages:
tara_ops: Vendor flagged a customs assortment hold. They propose split routing: rush 5 H100 by airdirect-to-depot, bulk 18 H100 via cross-dock sea. Need quick decision on air surcharge vs service impact to eu-west.

vendor_kai: Correct 1. Airdirect adds $1.3k/unit + expedited clearance. Cross-dock keeps standard freight but +7-9d. We can include QR-coded RMA labels and a serial->temp mapping CSV. Insurance options: vendor 30% / customer 70% or vendor covers freight if you accept the air surcharge.

mike_fin: Budget note: +6.5k surcharge if air 5. We can approve as emergency with PO amend. Prefer vendor 30/70 insurance but require vendor photo-evidence clause and shock-log for DOA disputes.

sylvie_infra: eu-west is running low on NVLink-capable nodes; two racks are degraded. If 5 early arrive they must go to racks r2/r7. Depot cross-dock can accept 10 crates Tue AM; direct depot needs 48h booking for power checks. Need original serials on AWB (no temp IDs) to avoid recon issues.

depot_luke: We can handle direct receipt for 5 crates if AWB + serials 24h prior. QR RMA labels speed intake. We'll need foam spec and an internal shock-read on receipt for warranty records.

tara_ops: vendor_kai 7 can you confirm AWB will carry original serials, include QR RMA labels on each crate, and that a printed photo-checklist is inside? Also need a 7-day RMA booking SLA for air DOAs.

vendor_kai: Will include original serials on AWB, QR RMA labels + photo checklist in-crate, and a packing shock-log. 7-day SLA for air DOAs OK. AWB preview: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/PK-4958. If you accept air surcharge we'll prepay duties for the air leg (+$420 flat).

mike_fin: If vendor prepays duties and includes the photo clause, finance will accept 30/70 insurance. I'll draft PO amendment with emergency code OPS-5410.

sylvie_infra: Ops: plan cordon/drain for r2/r7 in two 90-min blocks. Do a single-node canary first. If only partial arrives stage replacements to avoid overloading depot.

tara_ops: Opening surge ticket OPS-5410: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5410. Scheduling canary tonight 23:30-00:00 UTC. Also need manifest + AWB in thread before we approve payment.

tracking-bot: manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/PK-4958 1 AWB PK-4958-01 created; ETA air 48h.

vendor_kai: ack 7 sending final AWB + invoice after PO amend. QR labels + shock-log will be printed and RMA labels inside crates.

depot_luke: ack 7 will reserve bench for power test once AWB and ETA confirmed.

mike_fin: ack 7 starting PO amend now, will post amendment ID in thread.

tara_ops: thanks team. Reply "ack" when AWB + PO amendment live and we'll close thread.
